technical.body: SyncSubscription key=(NodeId,ProjectId,Branch) contains HubEpoch UUID, PublishedHead, PublishedGeneration int64, DesiredGeneration int64, ReportedGeneration int64, WorkerEpoch int64, AcceptedHead, Outcome and timestamps. POST control/poll is read-only. POST control/report includes all epochs and observed generation; stale worker=409 stale_worker_epoch, stale hub=409 hub_epoch_changed. Poll every30s with20% jitter; commit/reconnect/on-demand wake immediately. Backoff1s doubling to60s. Generation ordering is valid only within HubEpoch. Restore generates a new non-reused random epoch before listeners reopen.

technical.body:
OperationReceipt binds requestId, node, project, branch, hubEpoch, candidate/result hashes and outcome. Durable refs pin candidates/reviews before receipt completion. Worker claims are fenced by WorkerEpoch; reconnect never trusts stored generation across HubEpoch. Fetch may advance remote-tracking refs, never dirty live refs. Restore first disables ingress, restores compatible data/control/audit checkpoints, creates new epoch, then re-advertises verified heads; node-held missing commits are uploaded and ancestry-validated before normal synchronization resumes.

Server: durable operation resume/status/safe cancellation. Plugin: expose resume, status and cancel with completed-versus-pending effects; never claim cancellation reverses published history.

HubRestoreFromOlderBackup is first owned by Ph5 (epoch/remote/control), extended by Ph6 (integration/review/audit resend), and repeated as isolated real-host acceptance in Ph8. Restore is tested, never assumed from successful backup creation.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given remote accepted A1 and reply was lost, when request R1 retries, then it returns A1 and the existing receipt; no A2 commit is created.
Given worker epoch changes4 to5, when epoch4 reports success, then409 stale_worker_epoch leaves current receipt and desired state unchanged.
Given B/main=C0 with title=draft, when A1 is fetched, then outcome=waiting_local_work, main stays C0 and title remains draft; at15min status/inbox shows the age warning.
Given B supports schema1 and incoming S1 requires schema2, when sync runs, then409 incompatible_schema leaves B's live data/head unchanged and records the required version.

Given operation R1 published A1 but its local reply was lost, when a plugin resumes, reads status and requests cancellation, then it shows publishedHead=A1 and a durable cancellation outcome for remaining work; it never claims A1 was rolled back or creates a second commit.

technical.body: Project history excludes secrets and automatic operational audit. This does NOT make audit local-only: every host retains permanent local audit and an append-only outbox delivers sanitized records to the hub unversioned ledger independently of project commits. AuditRecord key=(OriginNodeId,RecordId UUID); fields ProjectId,EntityKind,EntityId,OriginSequence int64,OccurredUtc,Actor,Action,PayloadVersion,PayloadHash,Payload. POST audit/batches validates token/project, inserts atomically by key and returns per-record durable receipts. Same key/hash is already_received; same key/different hash=409 audit_id_conflict. No UPDATE/DELETE permission. Local pruning is forbidden. Migration backfills TODO and generic audit history with counts/hashes and receipts. Credential values are excluded at capture, not silently replicated.

technical.body:
Reuse existing Duende IdentityServer. Provision client fed.node.{NodeId} per single-user node, bound to ownerSubjectId through authenticated operator enrollment. Client credentials issue short-lived reference access tokens; audience qbrain-federation and scopes fed.project.{ProjectId}.{read|publish|control|audit|enroll}; protected actions additionally require server membership/branch permission. Gateway introspects without positive caching for each new request and rechecks before publication commit; unavailable identity returns503 identity_unavailable. Revoke through IdentityServer: disable client and remove its persisted reference grants. Gateway rejects inactive tokens401 invalid_token; do not invent a revocation ledger. Native remotesapi uses gateway-held credentials over loopback; clients cannot access it directly. Ph0 proves token injection/relay including redirects/object URLs, project isolation and no public-ref bypass.

Server: least-privilege capabilities plus server-side authorization on every call. Plugin: show available rights and explicit denial; capability display never substitutes for authorization.

Ph0 B5 binds the exact restored Duende 7.4 patch and matching source-tag/API references, and proves issuance, introspection, grant removal and revocation against that binary. General/v8 documentation alone cannot close B5.
